references.label: Etihad Stadium
references.basis: Reported build cost, 2002 (nominal, not inflation-adjusted). Built as the City of Manchester Stadium for the Commonwealth Games; City's own ground.

references.label: Emirates Stadium
references.basis: Reported build cost, opened 2006 (nominal, not inflation-adjusted). Arsenal's ground.

references.label: Wembley Stadium
references.basis: Reported final build cost, opened 2007 (nominal, not inflation-adjusted). The original budget was reported as £757m.
references.note: Budget £757m; reported final cost £798m. This site uses the final figure.

references.label: Tottenham Hotspur Stadium
references.basis: Widely reported cost of about £1bn, opened 2019 (nominal). Spurs have not published a final figure; some reports put it higher, so this is the low end and understates the comparison.
references.note: Reports range from about £1bn upward; the low end is used.

references.label: Tesla Model 3
references.basis: UK list price of the Model 3 Standard, 2026. List prices change; check the sources for the current figure.

sources.outlet: EV Powered — Model 3 Standard UK pricing

revenue_mix.note: From the club's own 2024-25 annual report.

sources.outlet: Manchester City — Annual Report 2025, Business Performance

revenue_mix.note: From Arsenal's published 2024-25 results. Arsenal played 30 home fixtures that season after reaching the Champions League semi-finals, which lifts matchday income.
Total, matchday and commercial as reported from Deloitte's Football Money League 2026. Broadcast is computed here as the remainder (total minus matchday minus commercial), not a reported figure.

sources.outlet: FC Business — Real Madrid tops Deloitte Football Money League

press_transfer_estimate.label: One press estimate of all fees since the 2008 takeover (Transfermarkt data, via Football Transfers, Sept 2023)
press_transfer_estimate.note: Context only. A third-party estimate up to Sept 2023; it is not the club's own accounting and other compilations differ.

attendance.label: Average home league attendance, 2024-25
attendance.note: Included for balance: City's crowds are large. Attendance figures vary slightly by source.
